title: Luke 4:5-8 — the kingdoms of the world offered to Jesus: lust of the eyes
summary: Luke 4:5-8 in English: the devil shows Jesus all the kingdoms of the world and offers them if Jesus will worship him; Jesus answers from Deuteronomy 6:13 that we worship and serve the LORD God only. The slide labels this temptation “Lust of the Eyes”.

text.text: 5 And he led Him up and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
6 And the devil said to Him, “I will give You all this domain and its glory; for it has been handed over to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.
7 “Therefore if You worship before me, it shall all be Yours.”
8 Jesus answered him, “It is written, ‘YOU SHALL WORSHIP THE LORD YOUR GOD AND SERVE HIM ONLY.’”

keywords: thou shalt worship the Lord thy God
